values.summary: Exact r5 review failed; bounded #296 remediation stopped because evidence-preserving quarantine classification and restart recovery require the reusable store transaction subsystem tracked by child blocker #297.

R5 P2: a successfully preserved quarantine blocks every later typed commit and has no typed classification, archive, cleanup, or resume route.
Cohesion stop: typed recovery subsystem scope was split to child blocker #297; no source remediation was attempted after r5 recovery.
